name: Rusting Antenna
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 7th; Slot none; Price 2,100 gp; Weight —.

DESCRIPTION

A rusting antenna can be used to make a melee touch attack that causes any non-magical metal object touched to swiftly rust and corrode. The object touched takes half its maximum hp in damage and gains the broken condition—a second hit destroys the item. Using the antenna does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Against creatures made of metal, a rusting antenna deals 3d6+7 points of damage. An attended object or a metal creature can attempt a DC 15 Reflex save to negate this effect.

A rusting antenna has only five charges and once expended the antenna withers to dust.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wand, rusting grasp or a removed antenna of a rust monster; Cost 1,050 gp.

VARIANT
